description: A long legitimate range (see main.zhang): twenty budgets over 34 years of months answer every page and query.

requests.bql: SELECT count(*) AS rows, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last FROM #budgets
SELECT name, count(*) AS months, sum(added) AS added, sum(activity) AS spent, last(available) AS left FROM #budgets GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
SELECT name, date, assigned, activity, available FROM #budgets WHERE year = 1995 AND month = 6 ORDER BY name
SELECT date, account, narration, units(position) AS units, budgets FROM #postings WHERE year = 2024 AND under(account, 'Expenses') ORDER BY account
